releaseNotes: v2.2.0 — Direct on-device streaming: stream links are fetched straight from the provider on your device for faster starts, with a remote-updatable provider registry so source domains can change without an app update. Self-healing playback: if a source dies or times out, the player auto-switches to the next provider (plus a new Try Another Server button). Continue Watching pre-warms streams for your top 3 resume titles, including the next episode of finished ones. Player overhaul: audio track sheet, subtitle sheet with search, player settings, stream picker, double-tap seek, first-run language prompt. Fixes: video/audio now stop when the app is minimized, back-press toast auto-hides, Continue Watching row scrolls horizontally, no stuck loading spinner after minimize.
